thesis: Q3 beat but guidance cut, CFO departure and JPM downgrade; news-backed gap down -24% on 6x volume, closed near lows (0.19). Post-earnings drift after bad news tends to continue as analysts cut estimates.
wrong_if: Stock rebounds above ~$32.5 with buyers stepping in on a dividend-yield/valuation bid.

thesis: Q3 GAAP net loss with large charge and ~$360M revenue shortfall; stock -18% on 6x volume, closed in lower quarter of range. Bad-news drift with estimate cuts likely; Barclays still overweight though so some bounce risk.
wrong_if: Charge proves one-off and analysts defend the stock, driving a retrace above ~$82.

thesis: Exceptional Q3 (record-high stock, favorable purchasing conditions) with +26% gap on 3.3x volume, closed at 0.97 of range while SPY fell 4.4% that day. Information-backed up-moves tend to drift as estimates rise; relative strength in a crash.
wrong_if: The stock gives back the gap within days, closing below ~115, showing the earnings pop was overdone.

thesis: Post-earnings bad-news drift (guidance cut, CFO exit, downgrades) is slow but intact: stock holds near its 52w low after a 24% gap, analysts cutting estimates. Extend 5 trading days; squeeze risk if market rebounds after NVDA earnings, so stop sits above the 30.5 spike high.
wrong_if: FIS closes back above ~30.5 on volume, i.e. the post-earnings low is rejected and shorts are squeezed.

thesis: WCN fell 8% (2.4x volume, closed near low, WM/RSG only -1%) on a methane eruption at the Chiquita Canyon landfill (6 workers treated, LA County health order, leak capped, evacuation lifted). No earnings or guidance change; Citi sees no change to 2027-28 cash remediation costs. A single-site headline shock in a $45B diversified compounder looks over-discounted and should partially retrace.
wrong_if: New regulatory, closure or liability disclosures at Chiquita Canyon, or the stock breaks below about 171 on rising volume.

thesis: Post-earnings bad-news drift (guidance cut, CFO exit, downgrades) continues: stock made a new 52w low at 27.47, +7.7% on the short. Market rebound risk after the NVDA beat, so the stop is tightened to about 7% above the fill, still above the 28-29 range.
wrong_if: FIS closes back above about 29.3 on a market-wide rebound or positive analyst or company news.

thesis: Insiders (EGI/Ventas) sold 8M shares at 14.50, an 18% discount to the 17.75 close. The stock gapped down 22.5% on supply, not on company news, and closed 14.40 (0.88 of range) on 8.9x volume. Q3 beat, FY EBITDA guide raised and PTs of 18-22 are intact. Company is buying back 1.5M shares at the offer price and underwriters hold a 30-day greenshoe, so 14.50 should act as support. Overhang is cleared and the supply-driven gap should partly retrace.
wrong_if: ARDT closes below the 13.46 offering-day low, or hospital-sector selling from the CRUSH rule drags it down despite the cleared overhang.
